contact.location: Live now, expanding to all major cities 🚀

pages.about: NOW delivers premium fresh meat in 30 minutes. We are expanding to all major cities in India.
pages.safety: Food safety is non-negotiable at NOW. Every item that reaches your home goes through a strict quality and hygiene process. We work with licensed suppliers, maintain cold chain, use food-grade packaging, and offer a 2-hour replacement guarantee if anything is wrong.
pages.privacy: We collect only what is needed to deliver your order: name, phone, address, and order history. We do not sell your data. You can request deletion anytime by messaging us on WhatsApp.
pages.terms: Orders can be cancelled before processing begins (within 5 minutes). Once meat is cleaned/cut, cancellation is not possible. Quality issues reported within 2 hours with a photo will be replaced or refunded.
pages.refund:
At NOW, every order is freshly prepared after confirmation. Therefore, refunds are available only in genuine cases.

✅ Eligible for Refund or Replacement:
• Wrong product delivered
• Product damaged/leaking
• Quality issue verified
• Order cancelled by NOW
• Missing items

❌ Refund NOT Provided:
• Customer changes mind
• Wrong address/phone
• Customer unavailable
• Product consumed
• Customer refuses without reason
• Minor delays (traffic/weather)

⚠️ Quality issues must be reported within 30 minutes with photo/video.
pages.delivery:
NOW delivers only within serviceable areas. Delivery charges and ETA calculated automatically.

Delivery may vary due to:
• Traffic & Weather
• High order volume
• Festivals & operations

If customer unavailable after attempts, order may be cancelled without refund.
pages.membership:
NOW Membership provides extra convenience and exclusive benefits.

Benefits may include:
• Reduced delivery charges
• Priority processing
• Exclusive offers
• Special rewards

Benefits available in eligible zones only. Non-transferable. Fee non-refundable.
pages.faq:
Q: How do I place an order?
A: Login, select products, choose delivery address, complete payment or COD, place order.

Q: Which products available?
A: Fresh Chicken and Fresh Mutton.

Q: Can I cancel?
A: Only before preparation begins. Once started, cancellation not possible.
